summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. filed an 8-K on July 10, 2026, disclosing preliminary assets under management (AUM) of $183.4 billion as of June 30, 2026, via a press release. This is a routine periodic business update, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard current report on Form 8-K under Item 8.01 for other events. There are no deal terms, advisors, or board actions. The disclosure is purely informational for investors tracking AUM trends.
